overlap_method: Active INCLUDEs only; cumulative TIME, addsat and to applied in Decimal; site-day matching within +/-1 day is conservative possible observation overlap, not proof of duplicate TOAs. Backend aliases effix/jbroach are grouped with their physical telescope; LEAP dates mark possible overlap for all five member sites. Original retained inputs may include rows excluded downstream, so unmatched counts are lower-bound opportunities. Exact match uses physical site, MJD and frequency only, not independent data claims.
